tool_args.rationale: The data exhibit nonmonotone response to s_grad, with high-gradient observations depressed relative to comparable lower-gradient observations, consistent with the supplied supercritical siphon mechanism. Fit its five parameters numerically against all nine paid rows; no oscillatory or chaotic signature is present.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Nine observations already span u_now and s_grad, including values above and below the suggested critical-gradient region; the known structured siphon model can be fitted directly.
It ignores s_grad, whose effect is evident across observations and whose value changes substantially.
It predicts smooth monotonic power dependence and cannot naturally represent gradient-linked decline/siphoning.
